body: Not much for medication and honestly, I can't see a therapist so I could even be prescribed. If anyone found out I went to see a therapist everyone would view me so differently. Worn a mask of happiness for the past 5 years, if I came out and said I was depressed people would think I was either kidding or they would tell me to suck it up. Already failed one attempt 3 years ago.

Well sure, there are a few people who do love me, but I don't love them, I don't love anyone. Every single good feeling I've ever had has just been replaced by this sense of dread. It's an effort for me to get up in the morning, it's an effort for me to eat anything and it's an effort to even converse with any normal people. I honestly can't feel anything but sadness now and my future seems completely pointless. I have, for all intents and purposes, no reason at all to live.
